description.value:
Prerequisites: White Mage 4, Vigor mage talent

Anytime a white mage casts a healing spell that overheals a creature, any excess healing over the creature's max hit points are temporary hit points that last for 1 minute (to a max of its class level or hit dice). This does not stack with any other forms of temporary hit points besides Vigor.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - White Mage (Mage Talents)
